decisions.reason: A cutting and creasing finisher close to the core portfolio costs little to keep as a distributed line, and its uncertainty is not yet resolved after one year.
The UV spot varnishing system is a distant, high-uncertainty flagship option with a recent German premiere, so it merits keeping open until market response is clearer.
The sheet preparation module builds on established systems and is cheap to keep as a complementary add-on, with no negative signal so far.
The B2 multifinisher is a flagship close to the core offer and aligned with the firm's automation direction, so there is a strong case for continued commitment.
The hybrid saddle stitcher fits the core booklet-making business, has low holding costs, and its value is still uncertain, so the option stays open.
The folding add-on already shows a documented customer installation working inline, which positively signals its value at little cost.
